headline: The only Soles4Souls employee in Denver says he always wanted this work, because it makes him part of something bigger than himself.
story: Josh is the warehouse coordinator, the only Soles4Souls employee in Denver. Asked if he is happy, he says yes: he always wanted this kind of work, and it lets him give back to people in need all over the world.

He runs on volunteers. Hundreds to thousands of shoes come in every week. The sorted shoes go to places like the Dominican Republic, Guatemala and Haiti, where they help people start a business and get out of poverty.
His happiness is being part of something bigger than him. His message: be the best human you can be.
